text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: SLO breach detected for /generate (p99 > 1.5s) in us-west-2. Automated severity: P1. Routing error rate up 23% over last 5m. Paging maya (oncall).

maya (oncall): I’m up, getting paged. Seeing spike on dashboards — p95 ~ 420ms, p99 jumping to 1.8s, streaming stalls reported by a few customers. Escalating to SRE.

ben (sre): On it. Can someone paste the PromQL we ran earlier? I want the per-router tail latency by policy.

nate (obs): Query: 
```
sum by(router,policy) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le+""="""1.5""} [5m])) / sum by(router,policy) (rate(requests_total[5m]))
```
This shows policy=prefer-local has p99 > 1.5 on routers r-usw2-0[3-5].

eli (runtime): I’m seeing heavy connection counts on those routers and a small subset of shards with very high queue depth — looks like a hot partition. Also ingest-side LB is sending ~30% more streaming handoffs to r-usw2-04.

zoe (eng-runtime): TL;DR: routing-policy-v2 was rolled out to us-west-2 ~2h ago. It changes weight calc for hotkeys. Could be a bug where weights become sticky and drive hotsharding.

carla (support): Customer impact: Support ticket stream shows 12 customers with streaming stalls and a few slow responses for SSO flows. We’ve tagged severity and notified top 3 enterprise accounts. No broad request failures yet.

maya (oncall): Ops-lead, propose we do immediate mitigation: 1) Pause routing-policy-v2 rollouts in us-west-2 2) Enable eager-fallback to standby model pool 3) Temporarily increase router pool in us-west-2 by +2 nodes. Comments?

ops-lead: Agree. Prioritize pause and eager-fallback. Scaling requires infra approval but ok as a short-term hotfix.

ben (sre): I’ll pause the rollout and flip a canary flag. Command: 
```
rctl rollout pause --name=routing-policy-v2 --region=us-west-2
rctl flag set --name=eager_fallback --region=us-west-2 --value=true
```
Executing now.

incident-bot: Action logged: rollout pause and flag set by ben.

eli (runtime): After the pause, I’m also enabling a temporary reroute policy to spread requests away from r-usw2-03 and r-usw2-04. Small script below to adjust weights: 
```
for R in r-usw2-03 r-usw2-04; do
  rctl lb weight set --router $R --weight 0.6
done
rctl lb weight set --router r-usw2-01 --weight 1.2
```
Applying now.

nate (obs): Dashboards updating — p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 1.3s within 90s of the weight change. Streaming stall reports reduced to 5.

zoe (eng-runtime): Good delta. But we should root-cause: the policy code computes weight = base + log(qps+1) * regionBias where regionBias comes from a stale config causing runaway for certain hotkeys. I’ll open a PR and also add a guard clamp.

ben (sre): For RCA we should capture a heap of metrics for the hot keys. Running quick extraction: 
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?expr=topk(50, sum by(key)(rate(requests_total{region="us-west-2"}[1m])))" 
```
Saving list to /tmp/hotkeys-4350012345.log and uploading to oncall-runbooks.

carla (support): Notifying impacted customers that we have mitigations in place and will follow up with timeline. Keeping PM and CS notified.

maya (oncall): Summary for now: mitigations applied (rollout paused, eager fallback enabled, lb weights adjusted). Observability shows p99 trending down but not yet back to normal. Keeping the page open; paging team if regression.

ops-lead: Recommend we schedule a live bridge for deeper triage and RCA after we stabilize (30-60m). Ben/zoe/eli please join. Carla will prepare the customer comms.

ben (sre): Joining bridge. Will collect logs from r-usw2-03 and 04 and correlate with routing-policy-v2 change window. If we confirm policy bug, plan: revert policy and ship clamp guard, then staged rollout with synthetic load.

zoe (eng-runtime): PR for clamp posted: https://git.internal/routing/pulls/789. Adding unit test for extreme qps cases.

incident-bot: Incident P1 > acknowledged. Pager duty incident created: PD-INC-2026-3321. Bridge: https://meet.internal/PD-INC-2026-3321.

nate (obs): Final quick note — add alerts for per-router hotkey imbalance (delta qps > 5x across shards) so this pattern triggers earlier. I’ll create alert rule after bridge.

maya (oncall): Thanks team. Keeping this thread pinned. I’ll update when we decide next steps (revert vs patch + redeploy).

carla (support): Posting initial customer advisory draft in #customer-notices for review.

eli (runtime): One more: check service mesh health on us-west-2 egress path, saw sporadic 502s earlier that could amplify backpressure. Adding that to RCA checklist.

ben (sre): Logged: follow-ups -> postmortem, rollback plan, alert tuning, policy clamp, extra integration tests.

maya (oncall): Closing loop for now: last_message_ts=4350012550. Will reopen if we see regression. :thumbsup:
